paper_reference: Tang et al., MiniCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of LLMs on Grounding Documents.
license: Apache-2.0 repository; lytang/MiniCheck-Flan-T5-Large model card declares MIT.
isolation: Install through the optional minicheck dependency group. Model weights are downloaded to the HuggingFace/MiniCheck cache, never Git.
model_retriever_requirements: Exact cited source_id/chunk_id evidence supplied by the normalized runner.

expected_output_mapping.stdin: Internal Python baseline; no external JSON runner is required.
expected_output_mapping.state: active or abstain emitted by the MiniCheck no-revision pipeline.

readiness_notes: Use the built-in MiniCheckNoRevisionBaseline. Unit tests mock model inference; the slow integration test runs only when the model is available.

state_support.active: native exact-chunk MiniCheck supported all accepted claims
state_support.abstain: native exact-chunk MiniCheck found insufficient support after retry
